sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [CARDINALITY] gen:IMO040Shape property constraint on nltl:iceAccretionLikely: The unconditional sh:minCount 1 and sh:maxCount 1 require every ship to record exactly one iceAccretionLikely value. The requirement only imposes equipment obligations when ice accretion is likely and does not mandate recording this applicability value, so a ship with no such value is incorrectly nonconformant.
